name: Lindy
desc: Personal AI agents for email, meetings and support
desc_zh: 面向邮件、会议与客户支持的个性化 AI 助理平台
solves: Email, meetings, and support messages eat up the day. Set up an assistant here to handle that traffic by rules you define.
solves_zh: 邮件、会议、客服消息每天占满时间。这里配一个助理，让它按你定的规则去处理这些往来。
best_for: You want to hand routine email and scheduling admin to an assistant.
best_for_zh: 你想把日常的邮件和日程杂事交给一个助理。
